capabilities: Import public YouTube captions as timestamped Markdown transcript notes into a chosen vault folder
Generate a grounded video summary via OpenRouter with optional web-search citation checking
Re-summarize an edited transcript note directly from the editor
Configure model, token ceiling, temperature, prompt, caption language, and web-search settings
Detect existing notes by youtube_video_id and never overwrite them
extras: Desktop-only and requires manual install from a repository build (marketplace submission is not done). Releases before 0.1.3 lack artifact attestations. Summary requests are paid and may be charged even when failed or cancelled; transcript-only imports need no key. The author accepts donations via Buy me a coffee.
intentEvidence: This is the standalone home of the Obsidian plugin, extracted from YouTube Transcript at commit 1787656.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a YouTube video's captions into vault notes or produce a grounded AI summary from them.
